clarifications.ensemble_prediction: arithmetic mean of equality probabilities from the two frozen checkpoints of the selected architecture
clarifications.model_selection: select architecture by mean of its two seeds' target-macro tuning ROC-AUC, then mean Brier score, parameter count, and architecture ID; retain both seed checkpoints
clarifications.novelty_policy_randomness: one frozen Gumbel variate per candidate, target, and acquisition seed; dynamic bonuses are updated lazily without changing the underlying variates
